BACKPORT: media: staging/intel-ipu3: parameter buffer refactoring Current ImgU driver processes and releases the parameter buffer immediately after queued from user. This does not align with other image buffers which are grouped in sets and used for the same frame. If user queues multiple parameter buffers continuously, only the last one will take effect. To make consistent buffers usage, this patch changes the parameter buffer handling and group parameter buffer with other image buffers for each frame. Each time driver will queue one more group of buffers when previous frame processed and buffers consumed by css. This prepares for making PortalDetector aware of layer 3 informations like DNS address list so that a single Trial can retry over different IP families on dual stack networks. This allows to avoid carrying the same arguments forward from one function to the next. chaps: Use crypto::ScopedEVP_MD_CTX OpenSSL 1.1 will use _new()/_free() semantics for all CTX types. 1.0 already does so for EVP_MD_CTX, so we can do the switch now, and, while we are at it, use the recommended _ex() forms for Init and Final. Furthermore, let's used the Scoped* version for better pointer lifetime tracking. Since we are just storing a unique_ptr in the struct, we can now pull it out of the union without bloating the struct size significantly. shill: vpn: Stop overridding SetConnection CL:1748120 introduced a regression by triggering a latent infinite loop that was not previously reachable because the previous SetConnection override did not work as "intended". Ever since it was introduced in CL:22461, the VPNService::SetConnection override essentially behaved as if it wasn't there at all. Since Device::DestroyConnection calls Service::SetConnection(nullptr) prior to destroying the Connection instance, and since rebinding a Binder does *not* cause--nor has it ever caused--the client_disconnect_callback to be called, the Binder in VPNService::SetConnection was never bound to a Connection during the destruction of the Connection. This change simply removes the override of SetConnection, as the previous implementation essentially behaved as if that was the case. BUG=chromium:996957 TEST=-All unit tests are passing. -Triggering a VPN disconnect after successfully connecting does not cause VPNDriver::OnConnectionDisconnected to be called (as was the behavior before CL:1748120). With l2tp, this is verified with: `cat /var/log/net.log | grep Underlying` Change-Id: Ief557c9b429dd55bedffc3aefaec4f1b6e6db680 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1769576 Tested-by: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Alex Khouderchah <akhouderchah@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>
